name: ap_create_table
description: Create a new table in the app. Table names must be unique within the app.

name: ap_list_tables
description: List tables of an app, optionally filtered by table name prefix.

name: ap_get_table_schema
description: Get the schema of a table: its fields, types and table options.

name: ap_drop_table
description: Delete a table and all of its rows.

name: ap_create_column
description: Create a field on an existing table (name, type, label).

name: ap_update_column
description: Change the type or label of an existing field.

name: ap_insert_rows
description: Insert one or more rows into a table.

name: ap_query_rows
description: Read rows from a table with filters, sorting and paging.

name: ap_count_rows
description: Count rows of a table, optionally grouped by a field.

name: ap_create_rule
description: Create a business rule that runs before or after insert/update on a table.

name: ap_create_widget
description: Create a UI widget with JSX source code.

name: ap_update_widget
description: Replace text inside a widget's JSX source (find/replace).

name: ap_get_widget
description: Read a widget's full JSX source.

name: ap_activate_update_set
description: Make an update set the current one so changes are recorded in it.

name: ap_login
description: Log in to the app backend.
